# Audio fixture provenance

`synthetic-a4.wav` is a repository-generated 48 kHz mono int16 strike from `synthesize(440, seed=7)`, normalized-partials-v1. No recorded person, instrument, or third-party media is used. The declared first partial is 440 Hz.

`audio_manifest.json` declares all 1,040 AT02 cases before benchmarking. A matching packaged copy ships in `pianotuner/data/` for wheel installations. Results retain every rejection and estimate.
